summary: A 5 star rated Parramatta agency should convert more owners, but a dead contact button and two brand names appear to cost you appraisal requests.

findings.problem: The main Contact button appears to link to #, so the key call to action goes nowhere.
findings.cost: Owners ready to ask for an appraisal hit a dead end.
findings.fix: A working contact and appraisal button.

findings.problem: The Sell, Rent and About menu items appear to link back to the homepage instead of their own pages.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot learn about your selling or rental service.
findings.fix: Real pages for each menu item.

findings.problem: The mobile contact link and the desktop contact link appear to go to different agency pages, and a link goes to a different brand domain.
findings.cost: Mixed branding makes owners unsure who they are dealing with.

findings.problem: The 5 star rated claim appears to have no review source or numbers, and no appraisal form appears.
findings.cost: Claims without proof do not persuade, and phone only contact loses after hours leads.
findings.fix: Embedded reviews and an online appraisal form.

redesign: One brand and real menu pages.
